reason: The official HM Land Registry title-plan guidance is directly readable without login and materially changes the method from INSPIRE semantics to title-plan/general-boundary semantics. It confirms that ordinary title plans identify general extent and normally use general boundaries rather than exact legal-boundary coordinates. Therefore this producer cannot promote a generic title-plan extent to canonical parcel geometry without target-specific register/plan context and, where precision is required, determined-boundary evidence. Spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
